title: Lior and the Rivergate
author: Dominic Voss
blurb: Isandro Fairweather, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
